text.6435310ef40b.text: What Europe's search for alternative healing can teach us: Mindfulness, Tram 22 Diaries

text.893449dd88d8.text: We are exhausted and need another way to live

text.639d808a665f.text: Personal growth does not always mean becoming more

text.4a73fa58813d.text: Spiritual balance also means planetary balance

text.9ac8a0217363.text: Building a bridge, not a shop

text.4d10d26cd441.text: There is a glimmer of joy I feel whenever I see a man wearing a Rudraksh beads

text.f4d28b78b4ec.text: , or an "Om" tattoo on a woman, here on the streets of Prague.

text.bfdec1cf146f.text: When I moved here, I expected the usual polite curiosity about India: about our food, the places to visit, the weddings. What I did not expect was how many people would want to talk to me about our lifestyle. Ayurveda, yoga, spirituality, and Hindu and Buddhist philosophy. There are yoga studios on every second corner,

text.1cc5cdda5e0c.text: are sold from rustic and boho shops, and people practise pranayama in the morning.

text.488e6cdf56ce.text: But none of it is really about India. It is about three things:

text.5919d61c3824.text: Mental and physical, and the growing sense that there must be another way to live.

text.fc24d19c4e39.text: that looks Eastward, and asks what to remove rather than what to add.

text.31a0d61a9310.text: reached through eco-friendly, non-extractive, centuries-old practices that were sidetracked on our march towards industrial and technological development.

text.8463a13e936c.text: Modern life has given humanity extraordinary things. But somewhere along the way, we became very good at developing the world around us while becoming less certain about how to care for the world within us.

text.58405c42047c.text: The reason Ayurveda, yoga, and Hindu and other Eastern philosophies land so well in the middle of a mental health crisis is that the burnout has structural causes. Europe has built an extraordinary standard of living on a work culture that leaves very little room for the nervous system, and people are noticing.

text.f20a9c1f28b9.text: Western medicine, brilliant as it is, tends to treat the mind as an organ that goes wrong. Ayurveda never separated the mind from the body, the body from the season, the season from what you eat, or any of it from how you live.

text.1401ca14fc7c.text: There is science behind these spiritual practices. But it is behavioural science mixed with a better poetry of life and earth. Oil on the scalp, warm food, sleeping and rising with the light, spices in food, silence in the first hour of the day. A psychologist would call these sleep hygiene, circadian regulation, and somatic self-soothing.

text.f4fb15b126ec.text: My mother calls it daily routine.

text.aab74d1e68b8.text: Yoga asanas are a preparation. A way of making the body quiet and flexible enough that the mind becomes bearable to sit inside.

text.7b6d56c98c10.text: Modern culture often teaches us that personal growth means adding. More knowledge, qualifications, wealth, experiences, achievements, followers. The list is endless. Ancient Eastern philosophies can offer a rather different question: what if growth sometimes means removing?

text.092d3f1e607b.text: The need to prove our existence.

text.16512fe500ab.text: Habits that keep us disconnected from our bodies, from other people, and from nature.

text.22e3890240a6.text: Yoga, meditation, Ayurveda and Buddhist traditions are enormously diverse and cannot simply be placed into one category called "Eastern wisdom". Yet many of them share an interest in awareness, balance, discipline, compassion, and the relationship between our inner life and the world around us.

text.2d07a72a8e33.text: That is perhaps why they resonate so strongly today. They invite us to become more conscious of the person we already are, rather than promising a better version of that person. And that can be a very different kind of personal growth.

text.ffd78610ce69.text: Wellbeing cannot ultimately be separated from the wellbeing of the planet. We can meditate in beautiful rooms, practise yoga every morning and fill our homes with calming Ayurvedic foods and fragrances. But if the way we live depends upon endless extraction, endless consumption and endless waste, something remains out of balance.

text.731aa22c719a.text: Many traditional societies understood something that industrial civilisation has often struggled to remember.

text.49f583c527d2.text: We are not separate from nature. We are nature.

text.bffacad37c92.text: Across India and elsewhere, generations developed ways of living with plants, natural fibres, herbs, oils, wood and clay that were closely connected to local environments and seasonal rhythms. None of this asks the earth for very much:

text.efc86adc8f4f.text: A copper vessel that lasts three generations.

text.7c6ee1acf572.text: Sesame oil pressed from a seed.

text.09c4f2d905bd.text: Textile woven on a natural handloom, strong enough to be passed from mothers to daughters.

text.6390e1bdb045.text: , grown in backyards rather than factories.

text.9fe76a4445ad.text: These practices were never designed to be extracted, scaled or discarded, because they came from a way of thinking in which the self, the household, the field and the season were one continuous system.

text.e693759cac56.text: We set that thinking aside for two centuries, believing it was the slow road. It turns out it was simply the road that could be walked forever. Of course, we should not romanticise the past: ancient ways of living were not automatically sustainable, perfect or universally applicable. But there is wisdom worth revisiting.

text.0013cde6aaa2.text: , and the small objects that make a practice possible. I started this work because I watched people here in Europe reaching towards traditions that my family, my culture and generations before me had held with respect for a very long time. Reaching for a slower relationship with the body, the mind and the world around them.

text.e7ecbba5bb20.text: And often, what they found first was the loudest and cheapest version of it. A mass-produced object stripped of its story of origin and place. Something presented as exotic, when it could have been presented simply as human.

text.990692e99256.text: I want to offer things with a little more care behind them, and not turn Indian culture into a costume or a marketing aesthetic. Things made by people, rather than designed to look handmade. Natural materials where they genuinely make sense. Handloom traditions seen as living crafts rather than decorative trends. Ayurvedic products approached with respect for the tradition behind them.

text.c298ae7eb059.text: Perhaps what I am really creating is more than a shop. It is a small bridge between worlds. Between an India that I know personally and a Europe that is asking new questions. Between old knowledge and modern life. Between consumption and conscious choice.

text.79d079558f4e.text: If someone buys a meditation shawl from me and it simply makes them feel comfortable while sitting quietly, that is already enough. If an Ayurvedic product encourages them to think differently about their daily routine, wonderful.

text.8a725f02c48e.text: Hopefully the object becomes an invitation: to slow down, learn, notice, practise, and perhaps eventually to need fewer things rather than more.

text.984a90232b6d.text: The best part is that Europe is already reaching towards these old traditions in its search for a healthier, calmer and more conscious way of living. It is not adopting Eastern practice as an aesthetic import. It is leading the way in recovering a technology of living that our own march towards progress mislaid.

text.32e2f9ca026d.text: And I am so excited to be part of this story.

text.cd83043704b3.text: Everything about Annamalai sets it apart from other South Indian restaurants in the city. They prepare dishes on the spot when you order (it takes time to arrive and is worth the wait). You can tell it is home cooked, tastes vary from day to day, as they are supposed to when being prepared fresh everytime, but everything remains tasty. Super light on the tummy, and you can vary the spice level by asking them. In any other place I would mind the TV blaring Indian songs, but somehow, the vibe of the place is so authentic, with underground, dim-lit room, small and cosy, adorned with old school decor, that the TV with songs back to back actually reminds me of local joints back home. I love the peace, you can spend good time without being disturbed. On weekends they do special combo meals like Chicken Biryani with Chicken 65, boiled egg and yoghurt (although I am vegetarian, my partner tried this and loved it). Staff is relaxed and respectful, and one of them is a freelance student of Charles University and is very attentive and polite. The only South Indian I keep going back to.

text.553d8f8278a5.text: How to style new-age Indian wear in Central Europe
text.553d8f8278a5.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.95a689305167.text: When people in Prague look for Indian fashion, they are pushed toward one narrow aesthetic — either the hippie movement of Goa or elaborate traditional wear like the sari or kurta. These hold their own cultural place, but they are increasingly dated, and they do not represent India's diverse and rapidly evolving fashion landscape.
text.95a689305167.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.4ea2c1468c23.text: Living in Prague and sharing my daily wardrobe choices, I frequently get questions from locals about where my outfits come from. Some even take my photos. The pieces that draw the most curiosity are not the glittering festival wear, but modern, structured garments made from breathable, hand-loomed fabrics.
text.4ea2c1468c23.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.cd1b76939020.text: In India, a significant fashion shift is under way. Designers are moving away from excess, focusing instead on minimalist silhouettes, sustainable practices, and heritage textiles adapted for global, everyday wear — bringing local artisans to the global fashion front and transforming traditional Indian clothes into contemporary silhouettes. For those in Czechia looking to diversify their wardrobe with unique, high-quality pieces, here is an introduction to the new age of Indian wear, and how it fits into the European aesthetic.
text.cd1b76939020.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.f2c0be427290.text: — showing how high-quality, design-led contemporary Indian pieces can find a second life in European closets. By choosing pre-owned or carefully sourced garments, we move away from mass-produced trends and toward a more conscious, globally inspired personal style.
text.f2c0be427290.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.603322009d7f.text: Here are the core contemporary movements changing how Indian fashion is viewed and loved abroad.
text.603322009d7f.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.5f1f51604440.text: Indian fashion commentary highlights a distinct transition toward earthy palettes, organic textures and functional design. In contrast to the stereotype of neon pinks and metallic golds, modern Indian everyday wear often embraces a subdued, sophisticated palette. Brands are pioneering a style that blends tropical ease with Scandinavian minimalism: simple linen shirt-dresses, ivory overlay jackets, and wide-leg trousers in olive, slate, terracotta and charcoal.
text.5f1f51604440.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.b8bb6db6cf9b.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.edfec93116a6.text: These pieces integrate into a capsule wardrobe. An ivory Chanderi silk-cotton tunic layered over fitted trousers or denim matches Prague's understated, elegant street style — and stays comfortable through tram commutes and café afternoons.
text.edfec93116a6.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.110cb65094b9.text: Sustainability sits at the core of the new Indian wear movement. Rather than mass-produced fast fashion, contemporary brands focus on slow, ethical production that supports rural artisans. They use hand-embroidered mirror work and appliqué on simple cotton dresses, keeping traditional crafts alive in modern cuts. Many are becoming renowned for preserving hand-block printing and using natural dyes to create intricate geometric and floral patterns on lightweight cotton.
text.110cb65094b9.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.d1cbba721118.text: For the eco-conscious Czech demographic that values durability and craftsmanship, these brands offer an alternative to high-street labels. A block-printed dress with a denim jacket and leather boots bridges the gap between traditional Indian craft and European autumn styling.
text.d1cbba721118.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.8b9897a5d026.text: For those seeking unique statement pieces, curated platforms aggregate a range of boutiques and design houses, offering a collective look at Indian fashion. On these platforms, fusion wear is reimagining traditional garments: longline capes printed with subtle Indian motifs like Ajrakh or Dabu, structured silk jackets, and asymmetrical tunics.
text.8b9897a5d026.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.c1ab8e713686.text: These garments function as wearable art. A structured, hand-woven jacket styled over a black turtleneck and tailored trousers gives a sophisticated layer for Prague's cooler seasons.
text.c1ab8e713686.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.2fd37fb8323b.text: Bringing these pieces into a European wardrobe does not require a complete style overhaul. It is about layering, balancing proportions, and mixing textures.
text.2fd37fb8323b.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.645be375ba77.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.bbef54de9bd4.text: a long cotton-silk tunic (historically worn as a kurta) works open as a light duster over a basic tee and jeans in spring.
text.bbef54de9bd4.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.6e7b6176efc8.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.329f8ad58ff8.text: pair a heavily textured, hand-spun cotton shirt with structured trousers or a skirt — raw, organic fabric against polished finishes.
text.329f8ad58ff8.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.3e9f47f9a312.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.ce8b54f3af23.text: instead of heavy jewellery, Indian styling leans on subtle-but-striking accents — several plain brass cuffs layered together, a hand-woven linen scarf, or a pair of flats (juttis).
text.ce8b54f3af23.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.92ca611ad30e.where: page text — first seen on diaries/contemporary-indian-wear.html

text.261af7c2ac23.text: The pieces I write about turn up on the Fashion shelf — block print, handloom, contemporary cuts. Hand-picked, in Europe, no slow shipping from India.

text.97e350703f9d.text: How to buy Indian clothes and goods from Guldaar Bazaar: Vinted for second-hand pieces, WhatsApp for new stock, shipping across Europe from Prague, returns, prices in euro, and privacy.
text.97e350703f9d.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.ca9f3095e726.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.6ae07a6e8907.text: Everything practical in one place, in plain words. Nothing here is a policy written by a lawyer to protect me from you — it is what actually happens.
text.6ae07a6e8907.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.42197953d380.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.13a39694d211.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.f14611b0e621.text: Measurements, fabric, how something actually fits — message me and I will tell you straight, including when a piece is not right for you.
text.f14611b0e621.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.9ef4d603606f.text: Second-hand pieces: buy them on Vinted.
text.9ef4d603606f.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.f11a9569d337.text: Every piece from my own collection links to its listing. Payment, postage and buyer protection are all handled there, so there is no separate checkout on this site and I never see your card details.
text.f11a9569d337.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.eec4bcdb9878.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.27d34d3ead3f.text: Cards marked with a shop name are new goods from a Prague supplier, not from my closet. Message me and I will confirm the price and postage before anything is paid.
text.27d34d3ead3f.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.e89da849fd2f.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.880e0c33fdf7.text: Second-hand pieces usually go within a day or two. New stock takes 5-10 business days across Europe.
text.880e0c33fdf7.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.22c9f33877ca.text: Pieces without a shop name are second-hand or one-of-a-kind from my own collection, so each exists once — when it is gone it is gone. Sizes are the label size; ask me for real measurements before you buy.
text.22c9f33877ca.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.3b7ccb952a05.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.42fc2b4abbdc.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.069eb3c2a3e4.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.0e12629f20ad.text: Prices are shown in euro. They are converted from Czech koruna at the European Central Bank reference rate and rounded to the nearest euro.
text.0e12629f20ad.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.a37bdb867596.text: Vinted charges in your own currency at checkout, so the amount you pay for a second-hand piece may differ slightly from the figure on the card. Prices on cards marked with a shop name are confirmed on WhatsApp before you pay anything.
text.a37bdb867596.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.ad5751430e29.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.f8c81fd579f8.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.e0c21db1583b.text: Postage is arranged and priced by Vinted when you buy, not by me. You choose the delivery option at checkout and Vinted shows you the cost before you pay. I post from Prague, usually within a day or two of the sale.
text.e0c21db1583b.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.88ea8b1fc841.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.a912ae60e1cf.text: I post these myself, from Prague, across Europe. Delivery is normally 5-10 business days. Postage depends on where you are and what you are ordering, so I confirm it with you on WhatsApp before anything is paid — you will never be asked to pay a figure you have not seen first.
text.a912ae60e1cf.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.16dcaa923f16.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.0ab8720baf11.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.84771203dc66.text: Vinted’s Buyer Protection applies, and their process is the one that governs the sale: if an item does not arrive, or does not match its description, you raise it with Vinted and they handle the refund. That protection is a large part of why the second-hand side of the wardrobe runs there rather than through a checkout of my own.
text.84771203dc66.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.3a392ab7db4a.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.e5f710534f9d.text: Here I am the seller, and EU consumer law applies: you have
text.e5f710534f9d.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.28a1c5a46e2e.text: 14 days from the day the parcel arrives to change your mind
text.28a1c5a46e2e.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.3bb8b2ab8e21.text: , without giving a reason. Tell me within those 14 days and send the item back, and I refund what you paid for it. Message me and I will tell you where to send it.
text.3bb8b2ab8e21.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.0ba7238a1667.text: Either way, if something arrives damaged or is not what the page said it was, message me. I would rather fix it than argue about who is technically right.
text.0ba7238a1667.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.dfb8a3d41335.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.1d5f22b2ada8.text: How do I actually buy something?
text.1d5f22b2ada8.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.9199c0ee98a4.text: If the piece is second-hand, click through to its Vinted listing and buy it there — payment and postage are handled by Vinted. If the card is marked with a shop name it is new stock, and you order it by messaging me on WhatsApp. There is no checkout on this site.
text.9199c0ee98a4.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.61a8ad8a9c71.text: Do you ship outside the Czech Republic?
text.61a8ad8a9c71.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.cc5adff8380f.text: Yes, across Europe. Second-hand pieces ship through Vinted to any country Vinted operates in, at the postage Vinted quotes you. New stock I post myself from Prague, normally arriving in 5-10 business days, at a postage cost I confirm with you before you pay.
text.cc5adff8380f.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.325c863605f4.text: What if it does not fit?
text.325c863605f4.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.6be73e26b0d8.text: Ask before you buy — that is the reliable fix. Sizes on the cards are the label size, and Indian label sizes do not map neatly onto European ones, so message me and I will measure the actual garment for you. If you have already bought: a Vinted purchase goes through Vinted’s Buyer Protection, and new stock ordered on WhatsApp carries the 14-day right to change your mind.
text.6be73e26b0d8.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.d25cc4acad96.text: Are the clothes second-hand or new?
text.d25cc4acad96.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.076948632032.text: Both, and the card tells you which. A card with no shop name on it is from my own wardrobe: second-hand or one-of-a-kind, and it exists exactly once. A card marked with a shop name is new stock from a Prague supplier. Every second-hand piece also carries its condition — new with tags, new without tags, very good, good or satisfactory — as Vinted grades it.
text.076948632032.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.8062940ecb2e.text: Why Vinted, instead of a shop on this website?
text.8062940ecb2e.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.aeb0087a2c1d.text: Because it is genuinely better for you. Vinted handles the payment, the postage label and the buyer protection, and it means I never see your card details and this site never has to ask you for them. It is also why there are no cookies, no accounts and no tracking here — there is nothing to track.
text.aeb0087a2c1d.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.54a57c3147c4.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.5ca5f1a0c1f9.text: This site sets no cookies and carries no trackers or advertising. Cloudflare counts visits anonymously, without cookies. There is no account to create and no form to fill in, so the site itself asks you for nothing at all.
text.5ca5f1a0c1f9.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.e0ec2e9582da.text: Two things are worth stating plainly rather than pretending otherwise:
text.e0ec2e9582da.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.8fa32e018740.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.2c66de7ec1ac.text: The site is served by Cloudflare, which keeps standard technical logs — including your IP address — to deliver pages and defend against attacks. That happens for every website; I do not use those logs for anything, and I cannot identify you from them.
text.2c66de7ec1ac.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.1d042b978421.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.bff154b69eaf.text: If you write on WhatsApp or by email, I have your message and whatever is in it — your number or address, and anything you tell me. I use it to answer you and to send an order if you place one. I do not add you to a mailing list, and I do not pass it to anyone.
text.bff154b69eaf.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.e4ca2f67f756.text: Links to Vinted, WhatsApp and other sites take you to services with their own privacy policies, which are theirs and not mine.
text.e4ca2f67f756.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.9eb5e522c2e1.text: Contact for anything about your data, including asking me to delete a conversation:
text.9eb5e522c2e1.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.a9f1259f2911.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.43ce37a4b96f.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.ede548996483.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.210091c77821.text: This site is a catalogue. It takes no payments and holds no accounts. Second-hand sales happen on Vinted under Vinted’s terms; new stock is ordered by message and agreed with me directly before payment.
text.210091c77821.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.a2ab674bd536.text: Second-hand pieces are one-of-a-kind. A listing can sell while you are looking at it, and availability shown here follows Vinted with a short delay.
text.a2ab674bd536.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.61eee8188b9b.text: Sizes shown are label sizes and photographs are of the actual item. Colours vary between screens.
text.61eee8188b9b.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.901ec5cd1bd6.text: Prices in euro are converted and rounded, as described above. The amount charged is the one shown at checkout on Vinted, or the one agreed with me for new stock.
text.901ec5cd1bd6.where: page text — first seen on how-it-works.html

text.25c36d57114a.text: Indian fashion is undergoing significant shift and it definitely does not include mandala prints, tie-dye, incense-shop ethno. That's a tourist's idea of India, not how anyone in Delhi or Mumbai dresses today. What I wear — and sell — comes from the design houses driving modern India: hand-blocked cotton, clean handloom, earthy colours, sustainable textiles and artisanal designs.

text.54a0760fc453.where: page text — first seen on wardrobe/fashion.html

text.1ef21027b279.text: If you've only met Indian clothing through Prague's ethno shops, these names will be new — so here's the short version of what you're actually buying, and why it's different.
text.1ef21027b279.where: page text — first seen on wardrobe/fashion.html

text.3e7ed009e485.where: page text — first seen on wardrobe/fashion.html

text.a20eeb8b66ea.text: Hand-carved wooden blocks, stamped by hand onto cotton.
text.a20eeb8b66ea.where: page text — first seen on wardrobe/fashion.html

text.0cd887b6805e.text: The tiny irregularities are the point — no two metres identical. The best of it is done slowly and ethically in Jaipur workshops. The opposite of printed-mandala fast fashion.
text.0cd887b6805e.where: page text — first seen on wardrobe/fashion.html

text.1e032e3b5597.where: page text — first seen on wardrobe/fashion.html

text.3f40de06e806.text: Fabric woven on a non-powered loom by a weaver, not a machine. It breathes differently, drapes differently, lasts. The good makers work directly with artisan communities, so a piece carries a maker, not just a label.
text.3f40de06e806.where: page text — first seen on wardrobe/fashion.html

text.96cbf798f14b.where: page text — first seen on wardrobe/fashion.html

text.fa475abbc149.text: These labels barely ship to Czechia. Buying my pre-loved pieces on Vinted is the easiest way to get the real thing locally —
text.fa475abbc149.where: page text — first seen on wardrobe/fashion.html

text.f3bb512321ff.text: and it keeps good clothes in circulation instead of landfill.
